programme.title: Manu Katché, Alfio Origlio, Walter Ricci & Jérôme Regard
programme.sub-title: Katché & Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity. He is accompanied by an exceptional rhythm section composed of Manu Katché on drums, Jérôme Regard on bass, and Alfio Origlio on piano. This concert was recorded at Festival Jazz au Sommet 2020 in France.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Muddy Waters, Horace Silver & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed three talented Americans: pianist Horace Silver, guitarist Muddy Waters, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, alongside their bands.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra & Michael Tilson Thomas
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer
programme.sub-title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.desc: Set in New Orleans, this is the story of a mysterious man, Nick Easter. Nick gets himself not only on the jury of a landmark case against a gun manufacturer, but as the foreman, in an attempt to influence the other jury members to vote a certain way.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Undercover Agent Malcolm Turner is back and this time he's out to expose the suspected designer of a deadly computer "worm" that would allow outside forces access to sophistical and critical government intelligence files.

programme.title: Monsieur Verdoux
programme.desc: A suave but cynical man supports his family by marrying and murdering rich women for their money, but the job has some occupational hazards.

programme.title: A Stork's Journey
programme.desc: Richard is a sparrow. Orphaned at birth and raised by storks, he believes that he is a stork, too! But when winter comes and his adoptive flock prepare to migrate to Africa, his true identity is revealed and his family must leave him behind in the forest with the other sparrows. Determined to prove he is a stork after all, Richard ventures south on an epic adventure, accompanied by friends big and small, to unleash his true potential and be reunited with his family.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: When his family goes on vacation, a young dog finds himself at a dog prison where he must escape with the help of his new friends.

programme.title: A Wizard's Tale
programme.desc: From the writer of Ice Age: The Meltdown and with a stellar voice cast, including Ian McShane (John Wick, Coraline), Lily Collins (Mirror Mirror) and Toby Kebbell (Ben-Hur, Warcraft), A WIZARD'S TALE is an uplifting magical journey that is guaranteed to cast its spell on adults and children alike. A WIZARD'S TALE is a magical family adventure about one boy's quest to restore happiness to the world after an evil wizard named “The Grump” casts an evil spell on a formerly happy land. Join Terry on his adventure, as he outwits a multitude of weird and wonderful creatures and finds friendship with Princess Dawn along the way. A.k.a. Here Comes the Grump

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace becomes a princess when a summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury "consultant" will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: A man discovers that he possesses the ability to instantly teleport anywhere in the world.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: A crew of miniature aliens operate a spaceship that has a human form

programme.title: Hannibal Rising
programme.desc: Young Hannibal begins plotting revenge after his baby sister is killed during World War II. Based on Thomas Harris' novel.

programme.title: The Son of No One
programme.desc: A cop is assigned to the neighborhood where he grew up, where an old secret threatens to destroy his family.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: A police psychologist works to talk down an ex-con who is threatening to jump from a Manhattan hotel rooftop.

programme.title: 2 Guns
programme.desc: Two hardened criminals get into trouble with the US border patrol after meeting with a Mexican drug lord.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Body Brokers
programme.desc: The true and untold story of a multi-billion dollar fraud on the healthcare system, where drug addicts and dealers became millionaires overnight.

programme.title: Bauhaus Spirit
programme.desc: Almost a hundred years ago, a radical artistic utopia was born in the city of Weimar Bauhaus. This is a fascinating look at how it still shapes our world today. Against the background of the 100th anniversary 'Bauhaus Spirit: 100 Years of Bauhaus' not only tells art history, but also contemporary history. Bauhaus made art, design and architecture political. The result was a spatial art form that wasn't above thinking about the distance between a bathtub and a toilet or the ideal chair. We go back to the beginning and celebrate the cultural history of modern spatial thinking that is as captivating as it is enlightening.

programme.title: Endings, Beginnings
programme.desc: Daphne (Woodley), a young woman recovering from a break-up is at a turning point in her life and embarks on a few months of self-introspection. But when she meets friends Jack (Dornan) and Frank (Stan) at a party, everything changes... Daphne becomes involved with both of them, starting a steamy and complicated love triangle.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate battle between robots and mankind! When teenager Sean (Callan McAuliffe: The Great Gatsby) sets out to join the Resistance, against the robots, the fate of the world lies in his hands. Hot on his heels however, is robot collaborator Mr. Smythe (Ben Kingsley: Iron Man 3). This exhilarating British sci-fi thriller, delivers a bombastic robot takeover that is not to be missed!

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Book of Love
programme.desc: When Penny, the light of Henry's life, is killed in a car crash, he puts everything on hold as he tries to come to terms with his loss. When his bereavement leave is over, everyone expects straight-laced Henry to return to work. But now everything has changed and Henry is not going back.

His clever ploys, however, lead to an unexpected result.

programme.title: Masterminds

programme.title: Gambit

programme.title: Made In America

programme.title: Little Big Horn

Overhearing their plans to flee, Donlin is heartbroken but continues his mission to warn General Custer of a massive Sioux buildup. Defying orders, he presses on, racing against time to reach Custer before disaster strikes.

programme.title: Only the Valiant
programme.desc: Capt. Richard Lance is unjustly held responsible, by his men and girlfriend, for an Indian massacre death of beloved Lt. Holloway. Holloway is killed while escorting a dangerous Indian chief to another fort's prison. The chief escapes. Knowing their fort is in danger of Indian attack, Lance takes a small group of army misfits to an abandoned nearby army fort to defend a mountain pass against the oncoming Indian assault. Their mission is to stall for time until reinforcements from another fort arrive. The men in this small group of malcontents, deserters, psychopaths and cowards all hate Capt. Lance and wish him dead. Much to their chagrin, the men recognize that Lance's survival instincts, military knowledge and leadership are the only chance the group has of staying alive.

programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

But first he promises King Edgar (Simon Callow) to find his missing daughter, Princess Luna (Piper Perabo), in exchange for a plot of land. George discovers the princess has been taken by a dragon, which apparently died after laying an egg. But Luna refuses to abandon the unhatched dragon, so George must return both princess and egg to the king -- while avoiding Luna's determined fiancé (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back

Meanwhile, Koji (Ryo Ishibashi), a Yakuza killer in town to meet with the local Mafia, turns the tables on a deranged terrorist who threatens to bomb an eatery. Corrupt cops bring Koji in, but he soon escapes from custody -- taking Malone and his daughter, Chelsea (Danielle Harris), hostage.

programme.title: Manu Katché, Alfio Origlio, Walter Ricci & Jérôme Regard
programme.sub-title: Katché & Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity. He is accompanied by an exceptional rhythm section composed of Manu Katché on drums, Jérôme Regard on bass, and Alfio Origlio on piano. This concert was recorded at Festival Jazz au Sommet 2020 in France.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: John Lee Hooker, Carey Bell, Jimmy Dawkins & Joe Harper
programme.sub-title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar). From the first to the very last minute of the concert, Hooker illustrates why he, 45 years later, was to be ranked 35th on Rolling Stone's 2015 list of 100 Greatest Guitarists: this bluesman is truly in a class of his own.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Muddy Waters, Horace Silver & Dizzy Gillespie
programme.sub-title: H. Silver, M. Waters, D. Gillespie - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. In 1968, the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam welcomed three talented Americans: pianist Horace Silver, guitarist Muddy Waters, and trumpeter Dizzy Gillespie, alongside their bands.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album On the Road the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the first of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: John Patitucci, Marco Pignataro, Joe Lovano & Terri Lyne Carrington
programme.sub-title: The Tällberg Foundation: "Jazz for the Planet
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano). This recording, titled 'Tällberg's Jazz for the Planet', was made in support of the Tällberg Foundation's message and aims to inspire positive climate action. Since 1981, the Tällberg Foundation has been trying to nurture new thinking, in part by looking at societal challenges through the lenses of artists.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra & Michael Tilson Thomas
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Tuva Semmingsen, Jihye Kim, Johan Karlström & Christine Nonbo Andersen
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program. Under the direction of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, Highlander, and The Chronicles of Narnia. Featured soloists in this concert are Danish soprano Christine Nonbo Andersen, Korean percussionist Jihye Kim, Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Swedish bass Johan Karlström, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in June 2019.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky
programme.sub-title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight', followed by Alexander Glazunov's Piano Sonata No. 2 in E minor, Op. 75. Then Lugansky performs a selection of works by Rachmaninoff: Rachmaninoff's piano transcription of J. S. Bach's Partita No. 3 in E major a selection of Études-Tableaux (Nos. 1, 2, 4, and 8, Op, 33, and Nos. 5 and 6, Op. 39) Lilac (Op. 21, No. 5) Prelude in C minor, Op. 23 No. 7 and Rachmaninoff's transcription of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Lullaby (Op. 16 No. 1). This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on June 4, 2021.

programme.title: Ragna Schirmer
programme.sub-title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828. Basing itself on her letters and diaries, her compositions, and on accounts from musicians who have intensively studied her music, this 2019 documentary offers a multi-angled perspective on Clara Schumann. It records the various places where she lived, and the cities she visited as a pianist. This thought-provoking film was directed by Andreas Morell and Magdalena Zieba-Schwind.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: Kiss is one of the legendary groups in Hard Rock history. They have millions of fans around the world and over 100 million records sold. KISS confirms why they have been the best on the scene for nearly four decades, in a performance that made history, impressing an audience of more than 85,000 people, in a show of more than 2 hours and packed with hits, held at the Nurburgring, Germany in 2010.

programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Dios Ama el Caviar es la fascinante historia de IOANNIS VARVAKIS y su viaje desde humilde pirata griego hasta convertirse en millonario internacional del caviar, con la confianza de Catalina la Grande de Rusia. Sin embargo, su riqueza y poder no le otorgan satisfacción, y su ambición desmedida solo le trae sufrimiento, hasta que lo entrega todo, incluso a sí mismo, en nombre del amor. Esta epopeya, basada en la vida real de Varvakis, se desarrolla desde la isla griega de Psara hasta la corte de Catalina la Grande en Rusia y las orillas del mar Caspio, para luego regresar a Grecia, un país desgarrado por la guerra civil y la lucha por la independencia durante la Revolución de 1821 contra el Imperio Otomano.

programme.title: Thor: god of thunder (esp)
programme.desc: Loki, el malvado tío de Thor, ha escapado de Asgard en busca de Yggdrasil, el Árbol de los Nueve Reinos, un árbol que contiene el poder del universo y que está oculto en la Tierra.

A principios del siglo XX, China se encuentra en crisis. El país está dividido en facciones enfrentadas, los ciudadanos pasan hambre y las recientes reformas políticas han empeorado la situación. La dinastía Qing, gobernada por un emperador de siete años y su despiadada madre, la emperatriz viuda Longyu, está completamente desconectada tras 250 años de poder incuestionable. Huang Xing acaba de regresar de Japón, donde estudió el arte de la guerra moderna. Al ver a su país desmoronarse, siente que no tiene otra opción que tomar las armas.

programme.title: Boonie Bears: Aventura En La Prehistoria
programme.desc: Vick y los osos están atrapados en el pasado con animales gigantes. Al separarse, se enfrentan nuevos retos.

programme.title: Madre Acosada

programme.title: Intrusos en Lake Pines

programme.title: Heartland

programme.title: Callejón sin salida
programme.desc: Un gánster herido y su compañero moribundo se refugian en un castillo frente a la playa tras su último golpe. Los dueños del castillo, anfitriones involuntarios de los criminales, son George, inglés maduro y dócil, y Teresa, su joven esposa francesa. Sin embargo, las relaciones entre ellos pronto comienzan a cambiar de manera extraña, dando un vuelco a sus desdibujadas vidas.

programme.title: Churchill
programme.desc: 96 horas antes del desembarco de Normandía, Winston Churchill muestra sus dudas respecto a la estrategia de la operación. Con el apoyo de su mujer y su equipo, el Primer Ministro Británico se verá obligado a enfrentarse directamente con sus generales y aliados norteamericanos, especialmente con el General Eisenhower. Mantener su liderazgo nunca fue tan relevante.

programme.title: El sureño
programme.desc: Sam Tucker, un esforzado jornalero del algodón que sueña con un futuro mejor para su familia, consigue tener su propia plantación, pero habrá de enfrentarse a un clima implacable, a una inesperada enfermedad y a la hostilidad de sus vecinos.

programme.title: Sí quiero, pero no quiero
programme.desc: Lauren, una joven divorciada que trabaja organizando bodas, se enamora del novio de una de sus clientas.

programme.title: Recuerdo
programme.desc: Gordon inventa la máquina "Rememory" que le permite ver los recuerdos tal y como fueron en realidad.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Mis Dos Amores
programme.desc: Un soltero que regresa al piso de sus padres, empieza a salir con una joven y el matrimonio parece cercano.

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott regresa a casa en Woodsboro. Pero su vuelta traerá también a su viejo enemigo: Ghostface.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Directores y actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York y narran historias de amor.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios

programme.title: Sin escapatoria

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido

programme.title: La lectora
programme.desc: Un novelista ciego tras un accidente de coche en el que también falleció su mujer, redescubre su pasión perdida por la vida y la escritura cuando comienza un romance con la mujer de un hombre de negocios condenado.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado. Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película sigue la leal amistad entre un profesor y su perro Akita. Hachi espera en la estación, incluso cuando su dueño ya no regresa.

programme.title: La Directora de orquesta
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales. Cuenta la historia de Antonia Brico, una joven que sueña en convertirse en directora de orquesta, pero nadie la toma en serio por ser una mujer.

programme.title: Mentes Brillantes
programme.desc: Antoine para las pruebas de acceso a la carrera de Medicina… Por tercera vez! Benjamin, acaba de finalizar el bachillerato y tiene que hacer su primera elección de Carrera. Pronto se dará cuenta de que no va a ser tan fácil como suponía…

programme.title: Una historia real
programme.desc: Cuando el desafortunado reportero del NY Times, Michael Finkel (Jonah Hill) conoce a Christian Longo (James Franco) –el cual ha robado su identidad– su investigación se convierte en una tensa persecución entre ratón y gato.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Walter y Kitty son una pareja de ingleses que deciden casarse por motivos equivocados y se establecen en Shanghai. En esta exótica ciudad, ella se enamora de otro hombre.

programme.title: La isla de Bergman
programme.desc: Una pareja de cineastas se retira a la isla de Fårö, donde vivió el director sueco Ingmar Bergman, en busca de inspiración para sus próximas películas. Según avanza el verano, aumenta su fascinación por los misteriosos paisajes de la isla, y la frontera entre realidad y ficción se desdibuja.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: Time
programme.desc: Es humano sufrir a causa del paso del tiempo. Temerosa de que su novio se aburra de ella, Seh-hee desaparece y se somete a una cirugía plástica.

programme.title: Mi Hostal Navideño
programme.desc: Jennifer es una ejecutiva cuyos padres deciden pasar la Navidad sin ella, decide dejar San Francisco y visitar el hostal que heredó de su abuela en Alaska para arreglarlo y venderlo.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Siete días y una vida
programme.desc: El mundo perfecto de una bella reportera de televisión Seattle queda desmoronado por la predicción de su muerte en siete días.

programme.title: Lío en Broadway
programme.desc: Durante los ensayos de un nuevo proyecto teatral se forma un triángulo amoroso entre una esposa, una ex-amante, y una de las actrices.

programme.title: Alto el fuego
programme.desc: Georges es un antiguo combatiente de la Primera Guerra Mundial que, traumatizado por los horrores sufridos en las trincheras, ha dejado todo atrás y ahora viaja por los vastos territorios de África Oriental. Tras cuatro años, esta vida nómada y aventurera le conduce a un callejón sin salida y decide regresar a casa, en Francia. El reencuentro con su familia y la sociedad posterior a la Gran Guerra es muy difícil. Pero Georges encuentra la complicidad de Hélène, una bella profesora de lenguaje de signos.

programme.title: Generación robada
programme.desc: En 1931, tres chicas aborígenes australianas –Molly, Gracie y Daisy– son raptadas por la policía para ser formadas en una institución gubernamental para trabajar como empleadas domésticas al servicio de la sociedad blanca. Al llegar les dicen que no tenían ya madres. Las tres niñas se escapan y emprenden una odisea de mil quinientas millas para poder regresar a casa.

programme.title: La delicadeza
programme.desc: Nathalie (Audrey Tautou) pierde en un accidente al hombre del que está perdidamente enamorada. Después de una etapa de duelo, no puede creerse que el amor llame de nuevo a su puerta de la mano de Markus, un compañero de trabajo que nunca ha tenido éxito con las mujeres, pero que rebosa bondad y ternura. Un hombre que para ella supone la vuelta a la vida.

programme.title: Mi amigo Mr. Morgan
programme.desc: Mr. Morgan es un terco anciano norteamericano que vive solo en París. Es viudo y lleva una vida aburrida hasta que conoce a Pauline. La vitalidad de la joven y su optimismo inquebrantable devuelven las ganas de vivir a Mr. Morgan. Ya sea visitando museos o haciendo excursiones al campo, la extraña pareja explora los tesoros de la amistad, la comodidad del compañerismo y el significado de la familia.

programme.title: El Turno Nocturno
programme.desc: Diego trabaja en una monótona estación de Gasolina. Situaciones desastrosas le sacan de su rutina.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Amanece en Edimburgo
programme.desc: Dos soldados regresan a su casa en Edimburgo para reanudar su vida romántica y familiar.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: La hermana del novio
programme.desc: Audrey cumplirá 40 años y su hermano se casará con una chica que conoció en Francia. Antes de la boda se revela un secreto, Audrey y la joven prometida no se llevan bien.

programme.title: Volvemos pronto con más contenido
programme.desc: ¡Estamos recuperando el sueño perdido! Permanece atento a la magnífica selección de entretenimiento de Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Asuntos de familia (2009)
programme.desc: Vince Rizzo es un funcionario de prisiones que descubre en la lista de nuevos reclusos un nombre familiar. Se trata de Tony, un hijo que tuvo 20 años atrás y que abandonó al no poder hacerse cargo de él. A pesar de estar de estar casado y con una familia distinta, Vince se lleva a Tony a casa...

programme.title: Mi segunda vez
programme.desc: La ganadora de un Oscar Catherine Zeta-Jones (“Chicago”) da vida a una mujer que, tras descubrir que su marido la engaña, se va a Nueva York y allí se enamora de un joven que le hará descubrir que las segundas oportunidades existen.

programme.title: Una noche con mi exsuegro
programme.desc: Durante una escala en Los Ángeles, el Señor Gallo, un testarudo y siempre ocupado hombre de negocios, decide ir a darle una sorpresa a su hija Ginnie. Pero una vez llega a su casa, descubre que ella se ha marchado sin dar explicaciones.

programme.title: Algo prestado
programme.desc: La vida de Rachel se complica cuando acaba celebrando su treinta cumpleaños acostándose con el prometido de su mejor amiga. Divertida comedia romántica protagonizada por Kate Hudson

programme.title: Aquí y ahora
programme.desc: El veterano escritor de comedias Charlie Burnz (Billy Crystal) entabla una improbable, aunque hilarante y conmovedora, amistad con la cantante de salón neoyorquina Emma Payge (Tiffany Haddish). Emma gana inesperadamente un almuerzo con la leyenda de la comedia, y su amistad tiene un comienzo extremadamente difícil (piense en la alergia a los mariscos, una visita al hospital y una pluma de epinefrina). En poco tiempo, cada uno encuentra en el otra una especie de alma gemela, forjando un profundo vínculo que deja de lado la brecha generacional y redefine el significado de la amistad, el amor y la confianza.

programme.title: Hunt For The Wilderpeople
programme.desc: Un niño rebelde y su atolondrado tío adoptivo, quienes se adentran en el bosque luego de una tragedia familiar, ignorantes que su misteriosa desaparición marcará el inicio de una intensa persecución de parte de las autoridades.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: En la pequeña ciudad turística de Nelson, Washington, el querido Jefe de bomberos C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) está acomplejado por su gran nariz. Una astrónoma, guapa e inteligente, Roxanne (Daryl Hannah), acude a la ciudad para estudiar un cometa y se siente inmediatamente atraída por otro recién llegado, el bombero profesional contratado por C.D. Chris (Rick Rossovich).

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Sonny Koufax (ADAM SANDLER) tiene 32 años y pasó toda su vida evadiendo responsabilidades. Cuando su novia lo deja por un hombre mayor, debe demostrar que está listo para crecer. En un desesperado último esfuerzo, Sonny adopta Julian, de cinco años (COLE SPROUSE, DYLAN SPROUSE) para impresionarla, pero no lo consigue... y no puede devolverlo. ¡Vaya problema para Sony!

programme.title: El día de los forajidos
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett es un ranchero que se enfrenta a los granjeros cuando los forajidos asaltan el pequeño pueblo. Los forajidos sólo son controlados por su notorio líder, pero se le diagnostica una herida mortal y el pueblo es un polvorín a punto de estallar.

programme.title: Ana Caulder
programme.desc: Tras ser brutalmente atacada y perder a su esposo, Hannie Caulder jura venganza contra los tres forajidos responsables. Con la ayuda del cazarrecompensas Thomas Price, aprende a manejar un arma y se convierte en una pistolera letal. Mientras los hermanos Clemens continúan su ola de crímenes, Hannie se prepara para enfrentarlos y hacer justicia.

programme.title: El regreso de los cuatro magníficos
programme.desc: El guardabosques retirado de Texas, Nash Crawford, vuelve a montar su antiguo equipo de guardabosques de los viejos tiempos para luchar contra el crimen en su ciudad natal.

programme.title: Compañeros mortales
programme.desc: Yellowleg, un exsoldado, mata accidentalmente al hijo de Kit Tilden. Para redimirse, la escolta junto a dos forajidos a través del peligroso territorio apache hasta Siringo, donde desea enterrar al niño. En el camino, enfrentan peligros y viejas heridas resurgen.

programme.title: Rifles apaches
programme.desc: En 1879, el capitán Jeff Stanton debe devolver a los apaches mescaleros a su reserva. Captura al hijo del jefe para negociar la paz, pero mineros codiciosos sabotean la tregua. Stanton es reemplazado por un coronel implacable, provocando el caos. Entre traiciones y conflictos, la lucha por la justicia y la paz toma un giro peligroso.

programme.title: Viven Entre Nosotros
programme.desc: A humanidade descobre que o vampirismo é um vírus real e que vampiros convivem entre nós. Para melhorar a relação entre espécies, uma família vampira aceita ser filmada por três documentaristas. Mas, enquanto revelam seu dia a dia “comum”, segredos surgem e intenções ocultas começam a ameaçar a frágil confiança.

programme.title: Suburbios del Alma
programme.desc: Clara y Miguel se cruzan, Luis y Viviana luchan por conectar con su hijo Marcos, y Lorena descubre la dureza del mundo. El mar y la arena observan cómo estas vidas se entrelazan, revelando los secretos más profundos de sus corazones.

programme.title: La Guarida del Lobo
programme.desc: Vicente ha sido herido y Toco lo acoge en su cabaña. El cambio en la pacífica relación que mantenían es provocado por un personaje que quiere las tierras de Toco. Pronto se desata el conflicto y se revelan secretos inesperados.

programme.title: Pueblo de cenizas
programme.desc: Miriam es atacada por el Duende, un ente sobrenatural que, bajo su apariencia inofensiva, sirve a las pasiones humanas y defiende con ferocidad su territorio. Un encuentro que revela el lado más oscuro de lo mágico y lo convierte en amenaza.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: Momo: Una aventura contrarreloj
programme.desc: Momo es una niña tímida y cariñosa que ha encontrado nuevos amigos y una casa en medio de las ruinas de un antiguo anfiteatro. Pero un día, repentinamente, los Hombres Grises irrumpen en la ciudad, con el objetivo de robar el tiempo a la gente. Momo desearía impedírselo, pero no sabe como… Casiopea, una pequeña tortuga mágica, la lleva a conocer al Maestro Hora, el Administrador del tiempo. Él es la única persona que puede ayudarla. Cuando regresa para luchar contra los Hombres Grises, se da cuenta de que ya no hay nadie con quien hablar o jugar y teme haber perdido para siempre a sus amigos. El mundo ha cambiado y todos han sido englobados en una nueva y rígida estructura social… A pesar de su repentina soledad, está decidida a intentar lo imposible para salvar a sus amigos y a la ciudad entera.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: A Valeria le ha cambiado la vida por completo. La separación de sus padres la ha llevado a trasladarse a Madrid con su madre. Eso supone muchas cosas nuevas. Casa, instituto, amigos…La cosa se complica todavía más cuando Valeria se ve obligada a asistir al grupo de terapia que organiza el psicólogo del instituto. Allí se encontrará con otros compañeros que también se ven obligados a ir pero lo que parece un mal comienzo paralajoven adolescente, no es más que el inicio de una increíble experiencia vital nuevos amigos, una ciudad llena de posibilidades, acariciar la madurez y sobre todo descubrir que el primer amor es bastante más complicado de lo que se dice en loscuentos de princesas.

programme.title: Mañana, cuando la guerra empiece
programme.desc: Cuando su país es invadido y sus familias secuestradas, ocho adolescentes se unen para luchar.

programme.title: El Lute II: mañana seré libre
programme.desc: Eleuterio se escapa de la cárcel, se une a sus hijos y emprende un viaje con su familia evitando la cacería de la Guardia Civil.

programme.title: Quién eres
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de María, una joven que busca formar parte de un grupo y que es bastante ingenua. Después de una gran discusión con su amiga Clara, decide pasar el rato hablando con Lucas, un hombre que ha conocido a través de internet y del que sabe más bien poco.

Cruz topará con personajes oscuros, algunos morirán misteriosamente, otros tienen entre manos planes siniestros.

programme.title: Simbad Y El Ojo Del Tigre
programme.desc: Simbad (Patrick Wayne), osado marino y príncipe de Bagdad, zarpa rumbo a Charnak para obtener la aprobación del príncipe Kassim para desposar a su hermana, Farah (Jane Seymour). Pero Simbad descubre que Kassim ha sido hechizado por su malévola madrastra, Zenobia (Margaret Whiting). Para romper el encantamiento, Simbad debe emprender un viaje como ningún otro jamás realizado.

programme.title: The Spirit
programme.desc: Denny Colt (Gabriel Macht) es un detective enmascarado, un héroe sin superpoderes que protege del crimen a los habitantes de Central City. Colt persigue sin tregua al villano Octopus (Samuel L. Jackson), que asesina sin piedad a cualquiera que le vea la cara. Adaptación de la novela gráfica de Will Eisner.

programme.title: Life: Vida
programme.desc: LIFE: VIDA es un aterrador thriller de ciencia ficción sobre un grupo de científicos a bordo de la Estación Espacial Internacional, cuya misión de reconocimiento acaba sumida en el pánico cuando descubren una forma de vida extraterrestre que evoluciona rápidamente y que ha causado la extinción en Marte. Ahora, amenaza a la tripulación y a toda la vida sobre la Tierra.

programme.title: La Ventana Secreta
programme.desc: Thriller basado en una novela de Stephen King. Depp es un escritor que atraviesa un mal momento: a la sequía creativa se une el proceso de separación de su esposa (Maria Bello).
